verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent is a business-services SaaS, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no mention of any MCP server: the only first-party probe was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge at robots.txt, and the lone community comment concerns SEO.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
